message: The other day, I was trying to teach my kids about fire safety, and let me tell you, it turned into a bit of a comedy show! I was earnestly explaining the importance of smoke alarms when my youngest chimed in, "But Mom, can we just use our superpowers to stop fires?" 🦸‍♂️ We ended up drawing our escape plan on a giant piece of paper—who knew it could turn into a family art project? It reminded me that keeping it light and fun can make these serious topics easier to digest. How do you keep safety conversations engaging with your little ones?
